title: XYZ Tileset Provider
description: Generic XYZ tile service. Use for pre-rendered tile caches, Mapbox tiles, or any {z}/{x}/{y} tile URL.

body.url: Tile URL template with {z}/{x}/{y} placeholders, e.g. 'https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png'.
body.type: Optional. Defaults to 'tileLayer'. Legacy fallback value 'wms' is also supported by the generic tile-layer adapter, but prefer the dedicated wms provider for new layers.
body.params: Only used when type='wms' on the legacy generic adapter. For new WMS integrations, use the wms provider instead.

examples.description: Legacy generic tile layer using WMS mode on xyz provider

notes: Note: the layer_provider value in the database is 'xyz tileset' (with a space), not 'xyz'.
Use body.url for current managed layers. Do not rely on a root-level url field.
Prefer COG for raster analysis layers where value-based interaction is needed.
For Mapbox tiles, the access token must be included in the URL.
interaction_config is required on the Layer record even when there is no popup behavior; use '{}'.
